name: the-block
description: Buyer side of a vehicle auction platform (OPENLANE coding challenge).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run build -w shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w e2e
